1.d4 d5 2.c4 e6 3.Nc3 Nf6 4.Nf3 Bb4 5.Bg.strategy: Supports the d4 pawn and opens the king's bishop, completing a solid set-up, and the queen can then support the pinned knight. White accepts that Black will challenge the centre at once, but keeps the more harmonious development.

Strikes at the d4 pawn immediately, using the pin on the c3 knight: White cannot easily capture without letting the bishop take the knight. Black takes the initiative in the centre and frees the position before White finishes developing.
1.d4 d5 2.c4 e6 3.Nc3 Nf6 4.Nf3 Bb4 5.Bg.name: Queen's Gambit Declined: Westphalian Variation
